description: Election Commission - Declare that R. A. S. Madusanka as a Member of the Kalutara P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination procedure by a recognized political party and the formal declaration of the new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
